name: World Cup Fantasy Optimizer
blurb: Picks the best legal fantasy squad under budget, then backtests itself against real World Cup 2026 results. Scores up to 3.8× a random squad.

name: SpecBar
blurb: Type a rough product idea and get a complete, leadership-ready spec in about 30 seconds: personas, competitor table, requirements, metrics, risks, launch posts. Downloads as a Word doc.
note: Free hosting: first load after a quiet spell can take ~50s.
